attempts.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, using a shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) with mode 2770 on both nodes. Verified cross-node consistent ownership by creating files from each side. Completed mandatory restart protocol on both nodes with proven boot-identity changes and post-restart recovery; discovered and fixed a persistence gap (missing netmount OpenRC service on node2) and validated the fix with a second reboot.
